1.consolidated_definition: No divulgable. Se dice de la información dada que no debe ser citada o repetida. Anglicismo crudo, usual. Pero de lo que tampoco hay duda es que nunca, ni off the record ni on the record, nadie ha dicho o tan siquiera insinuado que el ídolo del barrio vegabajeño Altos de Cuba, ha dado positivo (El Nuevo Día, 19-12-07)
1.en_consolidated_definition: Non-disclosable. Said of information that should not be cited or repeated. Raw anglicism, common. However, there is no doubt that neither off the record nor on the record has anyone said or even hinted that the idol from the Vegabajeño neighborhood in Altos de Cuba has tested positive (El Nuevo Día, 19-12-07)
